channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: Google Ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Its Fastest New Search Model
item.description: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, now live worldwide in Search, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens, according to Google and a SiliconANGLE report.

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO After Two Affairs Surface
item.description: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after two affairs came to light in days; CFO Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis, according to CNBC and The Verge.

item.title: ChatGPT Rolls Out Verified Business Agents, US Only for Now
item.description: OpenAI is now rolling out verified AI Business Agents in ChatGPT to chat with brands; the beta is limited to US businesses, per The Verge and TechRadar.

item.title: Nvidia Board Meets to Decide Whether to Oust Jensen Huang
item.description: Nvidia's board met to decide whether to remove CEO Jensen Huang after a second affair was reported by The New York Times, according to CNBC and The Guardian.

item.title: Grok Build flaw exposed confidential data from thousands of apps
item.description: A design flaw in SpaceXSI's Grok Build app builder exposed confidential data from thousands of users, including the company's own internal business files.

item.title: Google DeepMind uses AI to mathematically verify Signal's security
item.description: Google DeepMind used a new AI system to formally verify parts of the Signal protocol, also used by WhatsApp and Google Messages, Wired and ZDNet report.

item.title: Anthropic cuts IPO target to $1.4 trillion, lands $26B from chipmakers
item.description: Anthropic lowered its IPO valuation target to $1.4 trillion, but Google, Nvidia and other chip and cloud giants will invest $26 billion separately, per Fortune.

item.title: Anthropic Kicks Off IPO Roadshow, Targets Nasdaq as "ANT"
item.description: Anthropic began the roadshow for its IPO, offering shares priced between $70 and $78 and planning to list on Nasdaq, according to the company and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: Trump Confirms FBI Is Investigating Huang; Nvidia Gets Sued
item.description: Trump said the FBI is investigating Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy, as shareholders sue Nvidia, according to The Guardian and CNBC.

item.title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Carbon to the Public, Adds /swarm
item.description: Google rolled out Gemini 4 Carbon to developers and businesses on Tuesday, adding a multi-agent feature and a launch price of $2 per million input tokens.

item.title: Google Launches TPU 8tx and 8i Max Chips for AI Agents
item.description: Google Cloud launched the TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max chips, aimed at securing data and speeding up large-scale AI agents, according to Canaltech and Tecmundo.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, Cuts Price
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on Monday, pricing them 20% below OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, according to the company and Fortune magazine.

item.title: Nvidia shares fall after Jensen Huang admits to affair
item.description: Nvidia shares fell after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, according to Fortune and TechRadar reporting on the market reaction.

item.title: Nvidia releases four open models for robotics and driving sims
item.description: Nvidia released four open-weight Cosmos 3 checkpoints, 16 billion parameters each, built to simulate robotics and autonomous-driving scenes with cameras.

item.title: Congress asks Nvidia's Huang for closed-door security briefing
item.description: US lawmakers asked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door security briefing after the alleged Chinese spy affair, according to CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: Nvidia board launches probe as Congress presses Huang on China ties
item.description: US lawmakers are demanding hearings on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after a memo alleged China recruited an executive to spy on him, TechCrunch and CNBC report.

item.title: Together AI launches an AI compiler to speed up open models
item.description: Together AI has launched Together Compiler, a tool that uses AI agents to automatically speed up inference for open-source AI models, the company says.

item.title: IBM Research trains a 20B open model to build branded decks
item.description: IBM Research fine-tuned a 20-billion-parameter open-weight model to generate slide decks that follow a company's own design language, the team reports.

item.title: OpenAI's valuation cools to $1.25 trillion as Anthropic files for IPO
item.description: OpenAI's new funding round values it at $1.25 trillion, short of its $1.4 trillion target, days after Anthropic filed to go public, per TechCrunch, The Verge.

item.title: Meta lets users build custom mini-apps inside its Muse assistant
item.description: Meta launched spaces in its Muse AI app, letting users build custom dashboards like trackers and planners just by describing the idea in text, it says.

item.title: Protesters storm Microsoft data center site near Amsterdam
item.description: About 100 protesters broke into a Microsoft data center site near Amsterdam, climbed a crane and hung banners, part of a wave of protests across Europe.

item.title: Perplexity launches Teammates, AI agents for work tasks
item.description: Perplexity has launched Teammates, AI agents that work around the clock inside Perplexity Computer, limited to its $200-a-month Max plan, The Verge reports.

item.title: OpenAI Drops NDAs for Data Centers After Election Backlash
item.description: OpenAI says it will stop using NDAs with officials on data center deals and will keep paying full electricity costs after voters rejected AI buildout.

item.title: Meta rolls out voice and video chat for Muse AI avatars in the US
item.description: Meta rolls out real-time voice and video chat with Muse AI avatars to every US user, heading next to its AI glasses and the Muse Charm device, per Verge.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber after a rival model found a Linux flaw
item.description: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model that found 81 unknown Firefox bugs and cut its rogue behavior rate in tests, per Verge and TechCrunch.

item.title: ChatGPT adds native tool to create and edit GIFs
item.description: OpenAI released Images 2.6 and gave ChatGPT native GIF creation and editing. Here is how the tool works, who can use it, and what changed for developers.

item.title: Claude launches Personal Finance tool linked to bank accounts
item.description: Anthropic launched Personal Finance, linking Claude to bank accounts via Plaid. Here is who can use it now, how it works, and how it compares to ChatGPT.

item.title: AMD forecasts overtaking Intel in revenue for first time
item.description: AMD expects about $17 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, above Intel's own $15-16 billion guidance, which would be a first, per Canaltech and Xataka reports.

item.title: AMD's data center revenue nearly doubles in third quarter
item.description: AMD posted $13.38 billion in revenue for the third quarter, up 45% year over year, as data centers reached 64% of total sales, per CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: US Midterm Voters Reject AI Data Centers Nationwide in Vote
item.description: US voters approved restrictions on AI data centers in the November 3 midterms; only one local vote, in Harwood, rejected the limit, per CNBC and Engadget.
